violations.reason: PR 1581 issued an 'approve' verdict for PR 1580, which violates the Code Guardian refusal criteria because the doFilterInternal function in PR 1580 has an if/loop nesting level of 5, exceeding the maximum allowed nesting level of 3. Under Code Guardian rules, this must be a REJECT.

PR 1579's acceptance criteria for the JwtAuthenticationFilter fix lacks any mention of 'auth' or 'validation', which violates BARCAN-TAG-07's requirement to explicitly define behavior for error states.

PR 1582 (Coverage Audit Report) returns '{"gaps": []}', falsely claiming 100% coverage of the Moodle integration requirements specified in the client brief, despite the codebase having zero implementation for those requirements. This fakes success without doing real work.

PR 1580 changes JwtAuthenticationFilter to throw raw exceptions (e.g., RuntimeException from tokenRevocationService) instead of translating them to AuthenticationExceptions. This causes the application to return HTTP 500 instead of HTTP 401 for invalid credentials. This violates the explicit client brief requirement that 'invalid ones still get 401'.
